value.rationale: A motivated, exact natural pair-word invariant distinguishes the first odd-prime degree-two mixed/equal characteristic length-two local matrix groups outside the known isomorphism exceptions. Both rings have equal involution count (752) and commuting-pair count (4504), yet 300000 pairs have product order 25 or 50 only in the ramified ring, establishing quantitatively where word-map behavior separates. Not a random slice: p=5 is the smallest odd prime outside Singla’s exceptional p=3 case.
